role: Publisher and victim of extremist violence
contribution: Faisal Arefin Dipan was a publisher known for publishing works by secular and rationalist writers, including Avijit Roy. He was killed in his publishing office in Dhaka on 31 October 2015.
context: His killing followed the 2013 Shahbag mobilization and a series of attacks on secular writers and publishers. The case formed part of Bangladesh's wider debate over extremist violence, publishing freedom, and accountability.
impact: Dipan became a symbol of the risks faced by publishers who supported critical and secular writing. His legacy connects the Shahbag-era culture of dissent to later concerns about violence against the publishing community.
highlight: Publisher killed in 2015 after supporting secular and rationalist writing in Bangladesh.
seoTitle: Faisal Arefin Dipan: Publisher and Victim of Extremist Violence
seoDescription: Learn about Faisal Arefin Dipan, the Bangladeshi publisher whose 2015 killing became part of the debate over secular writing and publishing freedom.
shortAnswer: Faisal Arefin Dipan was a publisher of secular writing who was killed in Dhaka on 31 October 2015.

faq.question: Who was Faisal Arefin Dipan?
faq.answer: He was a Bangladeshi publisher known for supporting secular and rationalist writers who was killed in Dhaka in October 2015.
